summary.title: Make Your Own Angular, Part 1: Scopes and Digest
summary.one_liner: Learn how AngularJS scopes and the digest cycle work by building a simplified version of them yourself, as the first part of a series.
takeaways: AngularJS scopes are the core data structure that holds application state and watchers
The digest loop is how AngularJS checks watched values for changes
Building a small version of scopes and digest clarifies how change detection works in JavaScript frameworks
summary.summary: This page is the author's personal homepage, not the tutorial text itself. The tutorial it links to is listed in the codecrafters build-your-own-x collection as part 1 of "Make Your Own AngularJS", covering scopes and the digest cycle. The page text lists the author's work, including the self-published book "Build Your Own AngularJS" (free to download), articles on change detection in JS frameworks, and Web Audio API tutorials. It does not contain the tutorial's implementation details, so the specifics here come from the title and listing only.
